executive_summary: Hove delivered a mixed 2024 with revenue declining 9% to DKK 169M due to exceptional 2023 comparables, but net profit increased 58% to DKK 5.7M driven by improved gross margins (36.3% vs 33.5%) and lower financial costs. The core wind turbine lubrication business remains strong, while geographic expansion shows mixed results - US and India positive, Turkey and Brazil disappointing. Management implemented DKK 3M cost savings and proposes the company's first dividend (DKK 0.14/share). 2025 guidance maintains current trajectory (revenue DKK 160-190M, EBITDA DKK 11-18M) with caution around US market uncertainty and wind industry margin pressure.
key_highlights: Net profit up 58% despite 9% revenue decline - improved profitability
Brazil GM dismissed due to continued underperformance
60% revenue growth and EBITDA more than doubled since IPO
IoT solution Hove Smart Lube launched commercially
Strong balance sheet: 77% solvency ratio, DKK 7.5M net debt
